description: Get information about the version of the Public API, a link to the documentation, and a date and time that can be used to verify the 'Date' header.

Authorization.description:
The authorization credentials:

- For HMAC authorization: include 'keyId', 'algorithm', 'headers', and 'signature' (refer to the "Authorization" section of the documentation for more details).

- For OAuth: use the access token in the header as: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Date.description:
The date and time at which the message was originated in 'RFC 1123' format. 

This header is required when using HMAC authentication, but should be omitted when using OAuth authorization.

name: get_api_info

outputSchema.description: Auxiliary information about the Public API.

title: Get Api Info
